# Doppler Gotchas

> Known Doppler patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [Renaming a Doppler secret without exposing its value](rename-secret-without-exposing-value.md): Doppler's API rename needs the value; pipe get --plain --raw into set --no-interactive, cmp, then delete the old name, discarding output. MEDIUM.
- [doppler configs tokens --json prints null for a config with no tokens](configs-tokens-json-null.md): iterate `json.load(...) or []`. LOW.
- [doppler secrets set prints the values it set](doppler-secrets-set-prints-the-values-it-set.md): piping a secret via stdin still echoes it in the table; discard stdout and list with --only-names. MEDIUM.
